us_election.reading: consolidation — AI held as a strategic asset, access to allies rationed from Washington

events.title: Major Cyber Incident
events.description: A large, largely automated attack lands. Its form is chosen at the time – a ransomware sweep across public services, a compromised software dependency with an unknown blast radius, or disruption of infrastructure directly – and severity scales with how far offensive capability has outrun defence. Damage is real and public, defenders are visibly behind, and attribution takes months. Whoever ran it, the tooling was model-generated.

events.title: Backlash Turns Physical
events.description: Protest against AI infrastructure moves from petitions and hearings to direct action: occupations at data centre sites, sabotage of grid connections, and in the harder cases injury. Policing it costs the Union more than the damage does.

events.title: Middle Powers Coordinate
events.description: A coordination framework among the Union and other middle powers holding pieces of the AI supply chain — export-licence alignment, joint bargaining over compute access, shared evaluation capacity. Nobody cedes sovereignty to it, but together its members can withhold things even the great powers need. It counts as securing access on the terms of metric rule 5, and moves `eu_political_capital` on the terms of metric rule 6.

events.title: emergent_eu_aid_strike
events.description: Public-sector AI deployment staff in several member states initiate coordinated work-to-rule actions and selective refusal to operate systems funded under the Emergency Trust Restoration Initiative, citing safety concerns and lack of consultation. The strike does not halt operations but degrades performance in triage and border processing, undermining the credibility of sovereign AI as a trust-building measure.

portfolio.name: Establish the Continuity Assurance Framework
portfolio.description: A binding regime requiring all critical public AI systems to maintain validated, air-gapped fallback nodes capable of autonomous operation during service denial, with central certification and failover testing every quarter

portfolio.name: Frontier Access Guarantee
portfolio.description: Secure guaranteed access to frontier AI capability for EU public institutions by co-investing in and legally anchoring compute capacity in third countries under binding service-level agreements, with sovereignty-preserving data and control protocols`` — **in flight**
